changelog:
Initial release of the Work Productivity Proactive Agent Workflow Helper.

- Provides guided, practical support for users seeking Proactive Agent-style workflows.
- Focuses on bug fixes, setup hardening, safety improvements, reliability, and adjacent skill creation based on validated user demand.
- Includes step-by-step planning, artifact generation, and verification routines for repeatable and actionable results.
- Local hardware–friendly approach: prioritizes scripts, checklists, and templates over cloud-dependent solutions.
- Triggered by keywords related to productivity, agents, automation, bug fixing, and transformation tasks.
